one_line: Early Western Cālukya king and patron of the Badami caves in 7th‑century Karnataka.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, athletic and broad‑shouldered with a sturdy warrior’s build.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, dark brown medium complexion, strong jaw, neatly trimmed mustache, short boxed beard along the jawline, a small tilaka on the forehead, and a calm but commanding default expression with sharp, focused eyes.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair pulled back into a medium‑height topknot at the back of the crown, sides and back neatly gathered; a narrow gold circlet with a central red cabochon rests across the forehead, and a folded deep‑red cloth band wraps under the circlet around the knot like a restrained turban tie.
appearance.costume: He wears a royal but practical Deccan outfit: an off‑white, slightly cream cotton angavastra draped over the left shoulder across the torso and around the back, leaving the right shoulder covered by a second layer of the same cloth; beneath it a fitted, half‑sleeved, knee‑length tunic in muted saffron‑ochre with a subtle woven border; around his waist a wide deep‑red cotton kamarband with narrow gold edging holds a pleated off‑white dhoti wrapped in the Deccan style to mid‑calf with a front fan‑like pleat; on his feet simple brown leather sandals; jewelry is noble but not excessive—broad flat gold armlets on both upper arms with incised floral motifs, a pair of medium‑sized circular gold earrings with a small central red stone, a single layered gold necklace with a central pendant, and a few slim gold bangles on the right wrist; all textiles look hand‑woven and slightly textured, without modern tailoring.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved iron sword with a simple steel blade, a plain bronze guard, and a dark wooden hilt wrapped in deep‑red cord, carried in a brown leather scabbard hanging from his left hip on a discreet belt beneath the kamarband.

ref_desc: Mangalesa is a sturdy, dark‑complexioned early Deccan king with a topknot under a gold circlet, wearing an off‑white angavastra over a saffron‑ochre tunic, deep‑red kamarband and off‑white dhoti, gold jewelry, and a curved sword in a brown leather scabbard, dominated by off‑white, deep red, saffron‑ochre, gold and dark brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style character model sheet of Mangalesa, an early 7th‑century Western Cālukya king from Badami: he is in his early 40s, athletic and broad‑shouldered, with an oval face, dark brown complexion, straight nose, strong jaw, neatly trimmed mustache and short boxed beard along the jawline, a small tilaka on his forehead, and a calm, commanding gaze. His thick black hair is pulled into a medium‑height topknot at the back of the crown, held by a narrow gold circlet with a central red stone and a folded deep‑red cloth band wrapping under the circlet around the knot. He wears an off‑white, slightly cream cotton angavastra draped over his left shoulder and across the torso, covering the right shoulder with a double layer, over a fitted, half‑sleeved, knee‑length tunic in muted saffron‑ochre with a subtle woven border. Around his waist is a wide deep‑red cotton kamarband with narrow gold edging, securing a pleated off‑white dhoti wrapped Deccan‑style to mid‑calf with a fan‑like front pleat; his feet are in simple brown leather sandals. He has broad flat gold armlets with floral motifs on both upper arms, medium circular gold earrings with small red stones, a single layered gold necklace with a central pendant, and a few slim gold bangles on his right wrist. At his left hip hangs his signature weapon: a long slightly curved iron sword with a plain steel blade, simple bronze guard, and dark wooden hilt wrapped in deep‑red cord, sheathed in a brown leather scabbard that tucks under the kamarband. Use a palette dominated by off‑white, deep red, saffron‑ochre, gold and dark brown, and present him in front, side and three‑quarter views with the sword clearly visible to emphasize consistent hair, face, costume details and proportions in a heroic yet historically grounded style.
